title: Documentation needs updating on PR#1759
body:
PR#1759 - @avereha: 'automatic DST/timezone' button removed from config, it seems to confuse people and it's not needed

We will need to update the documentation for this change: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/1759
(See also May 22, commit#1a2e846566dadc594158e7ac9912af83c6ef3512)
